description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named ChatSheet which manages a chat interface within an iOS app. It sets up view models, handles dismissal, and configures UI elements such as the navigation title and toolbar.

classes.name: ChatSheet
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that provides a chat interface with dismiss functionality and dynamic title.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ChatSheet with a gateway session, session key, and optional agent name and user accent color.

methods.name: chatTitle
methods.description: Computes the chat window title based on the agent's name.
